title: Webhooks API
description: The Webhooks API lets you register and manage HTTPS endpoints that Surfboard calls when events happen on a merchant account. Create a webhook to subscribe to the events you care about, list your configured webhooks, update a webhook's URL, name, alert email or event subscriptions, activate a webhook against your demo or live environment, and disable one you no longer need. Webhooks are managed at partner level by default, or scoped to a merchant by sending the `MERCHANT-ID` header.

apis.heading: List Webhooks
apis.description: Retrieve a paginated list of the webhooks configured on the authenticated account, including each webhook's URL, subscribed events, alert email, and whether it is active and has passed its delivery test. Send the `MERCHANT-ID` header to manage a specific merchant's webhooks; omit it to manage the partner's own webhooks.
apis.query: Page through results with the `page` query parameter, for example `?page=2`. When omitted, the first page is returned.

reqParams.name: page
reqParams.description: Page of results to return. Defaults to the first page when omitted or not a number.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: The webhooks configured on the account for the current page.

resParams.name: webhookId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the webhook.

resParams.name: webhookName
resParams.description: The display name you gave the webhook.

resParams.name: webhookUrl
resParams.description: The HTTPS endpoint Surfboard delivers events to.

resParams.name: active
resParams.description: Whether the webhook is currently active and receiving events.

resParams.name: alertEmail
resParams.description: Email address notified when webhook delivery repeatedly fails.

resParams.name: tested
resParams.description: Whether the webhook has passed a delivery test against its endpoint.

resParams.name: events
resParams.description: The event types this webhook is subscribed to.

resParams.name: createdAt
resParams.description: When the webhook was created, in ISO 8601 format.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Create Webhook
apis.description: Register a new webhook so Surfboard can deliver events to your endpoint. Supply the HTTPS URL to deliver to, a display name, the event types to subscribe to, and an email to alert on repeated delivery failures. The response returns the new webhook's identifier and the signing certificate you use to verify that incoming deliveries came from Surfboard. Send the `MERCHANT-ID` header to manage a specific merchant's webhooks; omit it to manage the partner's own webhooks.

reqParams.name: webhookUrl
reqParams.description: The HTTPS endpoint Surfboard should deliver events to.

reqParams.name: webhookName
reqParams.description: A display name for the webhook, used to identify it in listings.

reqParams.name: events
reqParams.description: The event types to subscribe this webhook to.

reqParams.name: alertEmail
reqParams.description: Email address to notify when webhook delivery repeatedly fails.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Details of the created webhook.

resParams.name: webhookId
resParams.description: Unique identifier of the newly created webhook.

resParams.name: webhookCertificate
resParams.description: Signing certificate used to verify that deliveries to your endpoint originated from Surfboard.

resParams.name: tested
resParams.description: Whether the webhook has passed a delivery test against its endpoint.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Update Webhook
apis.description: Update a webhook's configuration. Supply the webhook identifier in the path and include only the fields you want to change; any field you omit is left untouched. Use this to point a webhook at a new URL, rename it, change the alert email, or adjust which events it is subscribed to. Send the `MERCHANT-ID` header to manage a specific merchant's webhooks; omit it to manage the partner's own webhooks.

reqParams.name: webhookId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the webhook to update, supplied in the URL path.

reqParams.name: webhookUrl
reqParams.description: New HTTPS endpoint to deliver events to. Omit to leave unchanged.

reqParams.name: webhookName
reqParams.description: New display name for the webhook. Omit to leave unchanged.

reqParams.name: alertEmail
reqParams.description: New email address to notify on repeated delivery failures. Omit to leave unchanged.

reqParams.name: events
reqParams.description: New set of event types to subscribe the webhook to. Omit to leave unchanged.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Activate Webhook
apis.description: Activate a webhook against a specific environment so it begins receiving events. Supply the webhook identifier in the path and the target environment in the body. Use this once your endpoint is ready to accept live deliveries. Send the `MERCHANT-ID` header to manage a specific merchant's webhooks; omit it to manage the partner's own webhooks.

reqParams.name: webhookId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the webhook to activate, supplied in the URL path.

reqParams.name: type
reqParams.description: Environment to activate the webhook in.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: data
resParams.description: Details of the activated webhook.

resParams.name: webhookId
resParams.description: Identifier of the activated webhook.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.

apis.heading: Disable Webhook
apis.description: Disable a webhook so Surfboard stops delivering events to it. Supply the webhook identifier in the URL path. The webhook remains on the account and can be reactivated later. Send the `MERCHANT-ID` header to manage a specific merchant's webhooks; omit it to manage the partner's own webhooks.

reqParams.name: webhookId
reqParams.description: Identifier of the webhook to disable, supplied in the URL path.

resParams.name: status
resParams.description: Status of the request, either 'SUCCESS' or 'ERROR'.

resParams.name: message
resParams.description: A message that describes the status of the request.
